use_case_summary: Product-facing in-app assistant + knowledge search for enterprise customers. Primary need: sub-50ms p95 for short-chat flows, embeddings for real-time doc search, reranking for search result quality. Cost sensitive to token volume spike behavior (usage spikes during releases).
notes: Background: BrightScale builds product analytics and wants native assistant inside product. Completed hosted API POC (2 weeks) — performance good, but want predictability and data isolation for paying customers. AE/SE summary: team impressed by latency and embedding quality. Current ask: Dedicated pricing term sheet that covers commit levels, ramp schedule, burst capacity, and overage pricing. Proposed commercial starting point discussed 100k tokens/day commit for first 3 months, ramp to 300-400k/day by month 6; burst allowance up to 1M tokens/day with defined burst window. Overages: customer's procurement wants clear line-item math (prefer flat per-token over percent). They asked for 12-month and 24-month commit options plus a 90-day ramp schedule and 2x overage rate cap. Technical constraints: VPC + SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logging retention 1 year, EU data residency for a subset of customers. SE notes: dedicated topology validated in sandbox; will need final runbook for failover/fallback to hosted for DR. Pricing discussion notes: they pushed back on high minimum commit; want smaller entry commit with deterministic burst pricing. Legal: DPA review outstanding (data residency clauses). Next actions: prepare term sheet with three commit tiers, explicit burst definition (burst windows and throttling), sample ramp schedule and monthly invoicing examples; schedule procurement + legal walkthrough. Quotes from stakeholders: "We like the hosted results but can't gamble on unpredictable costs for customers"; "Need a clear overage formula we can show finance."
